mapper.sql: SELECT ATNDLC.ATNDLC_ID , ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID , ATNDLC.USER_ID , ATNDLC.SCYR , ATNDLC.CMCRS_GBNCD , ATNDLC.AUDITYN , USR.USER_RPRS_ID , USR.STDNT_NO , USR.USERNM , USR.DSBLYN , DEPT.DEPT_ID , DEPT.DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ATNDLC.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID WHERE ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.listBbsAtclPaging 설 명 : 게시글 목록 페이징 */
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.bbsAtclHitsUserLog 설 명 : 게시글 조회수 수정 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD T USING DUAL ON (T.VWER_ID = #{userId} AND T.ATCL_ID = #{atclId}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.INQ_DTTM = FN_DTTM() /* 마지막 조회일시 갱신 */ WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( VWER_ID , ATCL_ID , INQ_DTTM , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , ORGNM , DEPT_ID , VWERNM , STDNT_NO ) VALUES ( #{userId} , #{atclId} , FN_DTTM() , #{userId} , FN_DTTM() , #{orgnm} , #{deptId} , (SELECT USERNM FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) , (SELECT STDNT_NO FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) )
/* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.bbsAtclHitsModify 설 명 : 게시글 조회수 수정 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL SET INQ_CNT = #{inqCnt} + 1 WHERE ATCL_ID = #{atclId}
mapper.insert:
/* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.insertCopyAtcl 설 명 : 게시글 복사 */ INSERT INTO TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL ( ATCL_ID , UP_ATCL_ID , BBS_ID , HDR_TYCD , SBJCT_ID , THMB_FILE_ID
, ATCL_TTL , ATCL_CTS , ATCL_TAG_CD , ATCL_LV , ATCL_SEQ , NTCYN , CMNT_USEYN , NTC_SDTTM , NTC_EDTTM
, ATHR_ID , EDTRYN , INQ_CNT , FVRT_USEYN , FVRT_CNT
, IMPT_ATCLYN
, DELYN , UNIV_CD , REF_CMNT_ID
, RGTR_ID , RGTRNM , REG_DTTM ) SELECT #{atclId} , NULL , #{bbsId} , HDR_TYCD , #{crsCreCd} , THMB_FILE_ID
, ATCL_TTL , ATCL_CTS , ATCL_TAG_CD , ATCL_LV , ATCL_SEQ , NTCYN , CMNT_USEYN , NTC_SDTTM , NTC_EDTTM
, ATHR_ID , EDTRYN , 0 , FVRT_USEYN , 0
, IMPT_ATCLYN
, DELYN , UNIV_CD , REF_CMNT_ID
, #{rgtrId} , (SELECT USERNM FROM TB_LMS_USR WHERE USER_ID = #{rgtrId})
, FN_DTTM_ADD_SEC(#{lineNo})
, FN_DTTM()
FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE ATCL_ID = #{copyAtclId}
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : BbsRltnDAO.updateBbsAtclForTrans 설 명 : 게시글 수정(선수강과목 이관용) */ UPDATE TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL A INNER JOIN TB_HOME_BBS_RLTN B ON A.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID SET A.BBS_ID = REPLACE(A.BBS_ID, #{rltnRefCd}, #{crsCreCd}) , A.SBJCT_ID = #{crsCreCd} WHERE B.RLTN_REF_CD = #{rltnRefCd}
mapper.select:
/* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.listRecentNotice 설 명 : 대시보드 전체 공지사항 목록 */
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
A.BBS_ID, A.ATCL_ID, A.ATCL_TTL,
A.INQ_CNT,
SUBSTR(A.REG_DTTM, 0, 8) AS REG_DTTM,
CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD WHERE ATCL_ID = A.ATCL_ID AND VWER_ID = #{vwerId}) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INQYN FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL A WHERE A.BBS_ID = #{bbsId}
AND ( A.UNIV_CD = 'P' OR A.UNIV_CD = #{uniCd} )
AND ( (A.DGRS_YR = #{haksaYear} AND A.DGRS_SMSTR = #{haksaTerm}) OR (A.DGRS_YR IS NULL AND A.DGRS_SMSTR IS NULL) )
ORDER BY A.REG_DTTM DESC ) A

/* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.selectNoAnswerAtclStatus 설 명 : QnA, 1:1상담 미답변수 정보 */
SELECT TOTAL_CNT , ANS_CNT , TOTAL_CNT - ANS_CNT AS NO_ANS_CNT FROM ( SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN ATCL.UP_ATCL_ID IS NULL AND ATCL.DELYN = 'N' THEN 1 END ) AS TOTAL_CNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN ATCL.UP_ATCL_ID IS NOT NULL AND ATCL.DELYN = 'N' THEN 1 END ) AS ANS_CNT FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_OFRNG SBJCT ON BBS.SBJCT_OFRNG_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_OFRNG_ID AND SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL ATCL ON BBS.BBS_ID = ATCL.BBS_ID WHERE BBS.SBJCT_OFRNG_ID = #{bbsId} AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = '1ON1' )
/* 설 명 : 게시판게시글 목록 조회 (페이징) SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.selectBbsAtclList */

/* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.selectBbsAtclGrpNtcList 설 명 : 게시판 > 과목공지 > 그룹 공지 사항 */ SELECT BGNT.BBS_GRP_NTC_TRGTR_ID , ATCL_ID , BGNT.DEPT_ID , (SELECT DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_DEPT WHERE DEPT_ID = BGNT.DEPT_ID) AS DEPTNM , BGNT.SBJCT_ID , BGNT.USER_ID , (SELECT USERNM FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = BGNT.USER_ID) AS USERNM , BGNT.DELYN , BGNT.RGTR_ID , BGNT.REG_DTTM , BGNT.MDFR_ID , BGNT.MOD_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_BBS_GRP_NTC_TRGTR BGNT WHERE 1=1
AND ATCL_ID = #{atclId}

/* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.selectBbsAtcl 설 명 : 게시판게시글 조회 */ SELECT A.ATCL_ID , A.BBS_ID , A.USER_ID , A.UP_ATCL_ID , A.ATCL_TTL , A.ATCL_CTS , A.ATCL_HASH_TAG_CTS , A.ATCL_LV , A.ATCL_SEQNO , A.FVRT_CNT , A.PROC_STSCD , A.RGTR_ID , A.REG_DTTM , A.MDFR_ID , A.MOD_DTTM , A.DELYN , A.OYN , A.RSRVYN , A.RSRV_SDTTM , A.RSRV_EDTTM , A.CMNT_PRMYN , A.NTC_GBNCD , A.AUTO_ALIM_SDTTM , A.AUTO_ALIM_EDTTM , A.AUTO_ALIMYN , A.ORG_ID , A.DEPT_ID , A.SBJCT_ID , A.DVCLAS_NO , B.ATCL_OPTN_ID , B.OPTN_CD , (SELECT ORGNM FROM TB_LMS_ORG WHERE ORG_ID = A.ORG_ID) AS ORGNM , (SELECT DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_DEPT WHERE DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID) AS DEPTNM , (SELECT SBJCTNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT WHERE SBJCT_ID = A.SBJCT_ID) AS SBJCTNM , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE UP_ATCL_ID = A.ATCL_ID AND DELYN = 'N') AS ANSWER_ATCL_CNT , CASE WHEN A.REG_DTTM > FN_DTTM_SUB(7) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_NEW , FN_REF_FILE_CNT(A.ATCL_ID) AS FILE_CNT , (SELECT USERNM FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.RGTR_ID) AS RGTRNM , (SELECT BBS_TYCD FROM TB_LMS_BBS WHERE BBS_ID = A.BBS_ID) AS BBS_TYCD , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD WHERE ATCL_ID = A.ATCL_ID) AS INQ_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_CMNT WHERE ATCL_ID = A.ATCL_ID AND (UP_ATCL_CMNT_ID IS NULL OR UP_ATCL_CMNT_ID = '0' OR UP_ATCL_CMNT_ID = '') AND DELYN = 'N' ) AS CMNT_CNT FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL A LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_OPTN B ON A.ATCL_ID = B.ATCL_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.ATCL_ID = #{atclId}

/* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.selecBbsAtclPrevNext 설 명 : 게시판 이전글/다음글 조회 */ SELECT Z.* , (SELECT ATCL_TTL FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE ATCL_ID = Z.PREV_ATCL_ID) AS PREV_ATCL_TTL , (SELECT ATCL_TTL FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE ATCL_ID = Z.NEXT_ATCL_ID) AS NEXT_ATCL_TTL FROM ( SELECT ATCL_ID , LEAD(X.ATCL_ID, 1) OVER (ORDER BY LINE_NO DESC) AS PREV_ATCL_ID , LAG(X.ATCL_ID, 1) OVER (ORDER BY LINE_NO DESC) AS NEXT_ATCL_ID FROM (
) X ) Z WHERE Z.ATCL_ID = #{atclId}
/* SQL ID : BbsViewDAO.bbsViewCntSelect 설 명 : 게시판 조회자 목록 수 */ SELECT INQ_CNT FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE ATCL_ID = #{atclId}
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.bbsAtclOptnRegist 설 명 : 게시글 > 게시글 옵션 저장 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_OPTN A USING ( SELECT #{atclOptnId} AS ATCL_OPTN_ID , #{atclId} AS ATCL_ID , (SELECT CD FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE UP_CD = 'SYS_NTC_OPTN_TYCD' AND CD = #{optnCd}) AS T_OPTN_CD , (SELECT CDNM FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE UP_CD = 'SYS_NTC_OPTN_TYCD' AND CD = #{optnCd}) AS T_OPTNNM , #{optnUseyn} AS T_OPTN_USEYN , #{optnSdttm} AS T_OPTN_SDTTM , #{optnEdttm} AS T_OPTN_EDTTM , #{rgtrId} AS T_RGTR_ID FROM DUAL ) B ON (A.ATCL_ID = B.ATCL_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.OPTN_CD = B.T_OPTN_CD , A.OPTNNM = B.T_OPTNNM , A.OPTN_USEYN = B.T_OPTN_USEYN , A.OPTN_SDTTM = B.T_OPTN_SDTTM , A.OPTN_EDTTM = B.T_OPTN_EDTTM , A.MDFR_ID = B.T_RGTR_ID , A.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ATCL_OPTN_ID , ATCL_ID , OPTN_CD , OPTNNM , OPTN_USEYN , OPTN_SDTTM , OPTN_EDTTM , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( B.ATCL_OPTN_ID , B.ATCL_ID , B.T_OPTN_CD , B.T_OPTNNM , B.T_OPTN_USEYN , B.T_OPTN_SDTTM , B.T_OPTN_EDTTM , B.T_RGTR_ID , FN_DTTM() )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.selectBbsSbjctDtlView 설 명 : 게시글 > 게시글 상세보기 */ SELECT B.ORG_ID , B.SBJCT_ID , C.OPTN_CD , C.OPTNNM , C.OPTN_USEYN , C.OPTN_SDTTM , C.OPTN_EDTTM , B.ATCL_TTL , B.ATCL_CTS , B.DVCLAS_NO , B.CMNT_PRMYN , B.RSRVYN , B.RSRV_SDTTM , B.RSRV_EDTTM , B.OYN , B.NTC_GBNCD , B.AUTO_ALIMYN , B.AUTO_ALIM_SDTTM , B.AUTO_ALIM_EDTTM , B.TEAM_GRP_ID , B.LRN_TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS A JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL B ON A.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_OPTN C ON B.ATCL_ID = C.ATCL_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND B.ATCL_ID = #{atclId}

/* SQL ID : StdInfoDAO.stdInfoListPaging 설 명 : 수강생 정보 목록 페이징 */
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.DEPTNM, A.USERNM, A.STDNT_NO) AS LINE_NO , A.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM (
) A WHERE 1=1
AND A.DSBLYN = 'N' AND A.AUDITYN = 'N'
AND A.DSBLYN = 'Y'
AND A.AUDITYN = 'Y'
AND ( LOWER(A.USER_RPRS_ID) LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(LOWER(#{searchValue})) OR LOWER(A.STDNT_NO) LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(LOWER(#{searchValue})) OR LOWER(A.USERNM) LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(LOWER(#{searchValue})) )

/* SQL ID : BbsAtclDAO.bbsGrpNtcStdntLrnList 설 명 : 학습요소 미참여자 목록 페이징 */ WITH BASE_STDNT AS ( SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND NVL(AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' )
, ASMT_TRGT AS ( SELECT ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID AS ROOT_ID , TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID AS TARGET_ID , TRGT.USER_ID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID, TRGT.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRGT_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END , TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID ) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT TRGT_ASMT ON TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID = TRGT.ASMT_ID AND TRGT_ASMT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(TRGT_ASMT.DELYN,'N') = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT ROOT_ASMT ON ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID = NVL(TRGT_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID, TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID) AND ROOT_ASMT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(ROOT_ASMT.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND ROOT_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID IS NULL AND ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_OYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = TRGT_ASMT.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND NVL(ATNDLC.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ) , LRN_TRGT (ROOT_ID, TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT ROOT_ID, TARGET_ID, USER_ID FROM ASMT_TRGT WHERE RN = 1 ) , DONE (TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT S.ASMT_ID, S.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN S WHERE NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND S.SBMSN_DTTM IS NOT NULL )
, EXAM_BASE AS ( SELECT B.EXAM_BSC_ID, D.EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL D ON D.EXAM_BSC_ID = B.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}
AND B.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ'
AND B.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID'
AND B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_LST','EXAM_LST_TEAM')
AND NVL(B.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(B.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(D.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' ) , LRN_TRGT (ROOT_ID, TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT EB.EXAM_BSC_ID, EB.EXAM_BSC_ID, A.USER_ID FROM EXAM_BASE EB JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR G WHERE G.EXAM_DTL_ID = EB.EXAM_DTL_ID ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT EB.EXAM_BSC_ID, EB.EXAM_BSC_ID, M.USER_ID FROM EXAM_BASE EB JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR G ON G.EXAM_DTL_ID = EB.EXAM_DTL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR M ON M.TEAM_ID = G.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.USER_ID = M.USER_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ) , DONE (TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT EB.EXAM_BSC_ID, TK.USER_ID FROM EXAM_BASE EB JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK ON TK.EXAM_DTL_ID = EB.EXAM_DTL_ID AND NVL(TK.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND TK.TKEXAM_CMPTNYN = 'Y' )
, LRN_TRGT (ROOT_ID, TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT S.SRVY_ID, S.SRVY_ID, A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY S JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND S.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND S.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL AND NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(S.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SUB WHERE SUB.UP_SRVY_ID = S.SRVY_ID AND NVL(SUB.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(SUB.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT ROOT.SRVY_ID, SUB.SRVY_ID, M.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY ROOT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SUB ON SUB.UP_SRVY_ID = ROOT.SRVY_ID AND NVL(SUB.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(SUB.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT G ON G.SRVY_ID = SUB.SRVY_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_ID = G.TEAM_ID AND TM.TEAM_CPST_CMPTNYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR M ON M.TEAM_ID = G.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = ROOT.SBJCT_ID AND A.USER_ID = M.USER_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE ROOT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ROOT.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND ROOT.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL AND NVL(ROOT.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(ROOT.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' ) , DONE (TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT P.SRVY_ID, P.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP P WHERE P.PTCP_EDTTM IS NOT NULL )
, LRN_TRGT (ROOT_ID, TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT D.DSCS_ID , CASE WHEN D.DSCS_UNIT_TYCD = 'TEAM' THEN SUB.DSCS_ID ELSE D.DSCS_ID END , A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS D JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = D.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_GRP_ID = D.TEAM_GRP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR M ON M.TEAM_ID = TM.TEAM_ID AND M.USER_ID = A.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS SUB ON SUB.UP_DSCS_ID = D.DSCS_ID AND SUB.TEAM_ID = TM.TEAM_ID AND NVL(SUB.DELYN,'N') = 'N' WHERE D.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND D.UP_DSCS_ID IS NULL AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND ( NVL(D.DSCS_UNIT_TYCD, 'GNRL') != 'TEAM' OR SUB.DSCS_ID IS NOT NULL ) ) , DONE (TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT A.DSCS_ID, A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL A WHERE NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N' UNION SELECT DISTINCT A2.DSCS_ID, C.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_CMNT C JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL A2 ON A2.DSCS_ATCL_ID = C.DSCS_ATCL_ID WHERE NVL(A2.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(C.DELYN,'N') = 'N' )
, LRN_TRGT (ROOT_ID, TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT S.SMNR_ID, S.SMNR_ID, TR.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SMNR S JOIN TB_LMS_SMNR_TRGTR TR ON TR.SMNR_ID = S.SMNR_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND A.USER_ID = TR.USER_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N' ) , DONE (TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ATD.SMNR_ID, ATD.ATNDE_ID FROM TB_LMS_SMNR_ATND ATD WHERE ATD.ATND_STSCD IN ('ATND','LATE') )
, LRN_TRGT (ROOT_ID, TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT S.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID, S.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID, A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL S JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N' ) , DONE (TARGET_ID, USER_ID) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID, L.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_BYWKNO_USER_LRN_STS L JOIN TB_LMS_BYWKNO_ATTNDNC_CRTR C ON C.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} WHERE L.PRGRT >= LEAST( C.LRN_PRD_IN_PRGRT , NVL(C.LATE_RCG_PRD_IN_PRGRT, C.LRN_PRD_IN_PRGRT) ) )
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY U.STDNT_NO ASC, U.USER_ID ASC) AS LINE_NO , U.USER_ID , U.USER_RPRS_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , DPT.DEPT_ID , DPT.DEPTNM , COUNT(DISTINCT T.ROOT_ID) AS NON_PTCP_CNT FROM LRN_TRGT T JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = T.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DPT ON DPT.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN DONE ON DONE.TARGET_ID = T.TARGET_ID AND DONE.USER_ID = T.USER_ID WHERE U.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND DONE.USER_ID IS NULL GROUP BY U.USER_ID, U.USERNM, U.STDNT_NO, DPT.DEPT_ID, DPT.DEPTNM, U.USER_RPRS_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T.ROOT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY U.STDNT_NO ASC, U.USER_ID ASC
